opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name, so the greeting is incomplete.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for the name and order number before discussing the order, which meets the verification requirement.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 804257, a lamp at €44.50, in transit for 13 working days. So nothing at all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue and used details the caller had already given without re-asking for them.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Right. I've opened a lost parcel investigation. It closes within 5 working days and then we send a replacement within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The investigation timeline and replacement timeline match the policy, and the 10-working-day threshold was met at 13 days.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank them on return, which the policy requires.

communication.quote: Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 12 working days and absolutely furious, this is a second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were furious and the agent never acknowledged it, and the agent's tone was curt; the frustration should have been acknowledged.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email when the investigation closes. Is there anything else thank you I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely.
